title: Semi-Device-Independent Certification for Nonlocality without Entanglement
summary: In this work, we present the framework for demonstrating and certifying the distinction between measurements in an entangled basis, called global measurements, and local operations and classical communication (LOCC), known as nonlocality without entanglement (NLWE). To be precise, we show NLWE via a maximum-confidence measurement in terms of a guess per detection event, called a confidence, a fine-grained guessing probability that encompasses both minimum-error and unambiguous state-discrimination strategies.
